title: Riverside Flash Flood & Storm Surge — Grand Avenue Corridor
description: Intense torrential rainfall (85mm in 90 minutes) combined with an upstream river surge. Floodwaters are inundating low-lying road corridors and threatening critical power and water lifelines feeding St. Jude Level-1 Trauma Center.

evidence.text_content: Grand Ave Underpass gauge reporting water level at 52cm and rising at 14cm/hr. Inundation alarm triggered.

evidence.source: Metro EMS Paramedic Unit 4B Radio Report
evidence.text_content: Grand Avenue Underpass impassable. Water depth estimated >45cm with submerged stalled vehicles. Attempting detour via Market Street.
Substation North-01 basement water intrusion sensors alarmed at 28cm. Critical transformer trip threshold is 30cm.

interventions.name: No Intervention (Baseline Progression)
interventions.description: Standard reactive protocol without proactive resource deployment or tactical routing. Uncontrolled cascading propagation through urban lifeline dependencies.

interventions.name: Intervention A: Northway Ridge Traffic Diversion & Emergency Corridor
interventions.description: Deploy traffic police and dynamic signage at 4th Ave Bridge to seal Grand Underpass before civilian vehicles stall. Establish priority emergency transit corridor along elevated Northway Ridge.

actions.name: Seal Grand Underpass & Establish Ridge Corridor
actions.description: Reroutes all emergency ambulances along high-elevation ridge (16.5m elevation).

interventions.name: Intervention B: Substation North Rapid Flood Barrier & High-Capacity Dewatering
interventions.description: Dispatch emergency public works strike team to deploy inflatable Tiger Dam flood barrier (1.2m crest) and 2x 750 gpm mobile dewatering pumps at Substation North-01.

actions.name: Deploy Tiger Dam Barrier at Substation North
actions.description: Guarantees electrical grid continuity for St. Jude Trauma Center and Rivergate Pumping Station.

interventions.name: Intervention C: Multi-Vector Resilient Response (Combined Mitigation)
interventions.description: Synchronized tactical intervention combining Northway Ridge emergency corridor, Substation North flood barrier deployment, and pre-positioning a mobile auxiliary generator at Rivergate Pumping Station.

actions.name: Northway Ridge Emergency Corridor
actions.description: Maintains rapid ambulance transit throughout event.

actions.name: Auxiliary Mobile Generator to Rivergate Pumping Station
actions.description: Preserves water service pressure for hospital sterilization and fire readiness.
